annotations.title: Put a picture on an item and get the link to buy it

description: Puts a picture (a public link, an upload id, an attached file or SVG markup) on an item and colour and returns the page where the person sees it, picks sizes and pays, with a picture of the result, how big each side prints, the price including US shipping, and any problems. With no picture, it returns the page where the person adds their own picture to the item. A shirt's front prints small on the left chest or big and centered; backs print large. No payment passes through this tool: the person pays on the returned page. Printing requires that the person owns the art or has permission to print it. Limit: 30 designs per address per hour.

back_image_url.description: A different picture for the back.

color.description: One of the item's colours; left out, its default.

dev.description: A developer's id, used with markup_usd.

file.description: A file the person attached, in the shape ChatGPT passes.

front.description: chest: small on the left chest (default). center: big and centered, on T-shirts, sweatshirts and hoodies.

image_url.description: A public http(s) link to the picture.

markup_usd.description: Dollars a developer adds to each item; the buyer sees the full price.

ref.description: The name of the assistant or app, such as "claude".

size.description: A size to start with on the page, such as "L".

svg.description: SVG markup (lettering or simple shapes) with a viewBox; scripts and linked files are removed. Fonts available: Lato, DejaVu Sans, DejaVu Serif, Liberation Sans, Liberation Serif, Nimbus Sans, URW Gothic, URW Bookman, C059, P052, Z003, Noto Color Emoji.

title.description: A name for the design (80 characters).

upload.description: An upload id, instead of image_url.

name: create_design
